chapter: Early bands around Bay St. Louis
title: Repertoire and banjo style in the early band
summary: The band played Panama, Sister Kate and Shaking the Breaks in a mix of slow drags, foxtrots and waltzes; Harry played straight four chords with raps on solos.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What we played: tunes and repertoire in the early days
